sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Explosive report from The New York Times suggests Congressman-elect George Santos may have lied about major events in his life.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的一份爆炸性报道显示，当选国会议员乔治·桑托斯可能在他生活中的重大事件上撒了谎。

sentences.en: Last year, Times reporting revealed the many lies that freshman Republican George Santos told about his life and his career.
sentences.zh: 去年，《时报》的报道揭露了共和党新人乔治·桑托斯对他生活和职业生涯所说的许多谎言。

sentences.en: Employers have no record of him, including Citigroup and Goldman Sachs.
sentences.zh: 雇主们没有他的记录，包括花旗集团和高盛。

sentences.en: Santos also claimed he graduated from New York's Baroque College.
sentences.zh: 桑托斯还声称他毕业于纽约的巴鲁克学院。

sentences.en: The school says there's no record of him ever attending.
sentences.zh: 学校表示没有他曾就读的记录。

sentences.en: Seems to be little to no evidence about the animal rescue group, Friends of Pets United.
sentences.zh: 关于动物救援组织“宠物联合之友”，似乎几乎没有证据。

sentences.en: The Times couldn't even find evidence.
sentences.zh: 《时报》甚至找不到证据。

sentences.en: He lives at the address where he's registered to vote.
sentences.zh: 他住在登记投票的地址。

sentences.en: Now, he's facing legal consequences.
sentences.zh: 现在，他正面临法律后果。

sentences.en: All right, we've got some interesting information for you here on Good Day.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们在《美好的一天》节目中为您带来了一些有趣的信息。

sentences.en: We just learned the exact federal charges Congressman George Santos is now facing.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚获悉国会议员乔治·桑托斯目前面临的确切联邦指控。

sentences.en: 13 counts in total stemming from wire fraud, money laundering.
sentences.zh: 总共13项指控，源于电信欺诈和洗钱。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Michael Gold on the 13 felony charges against Santos and what it means for his role in Congress.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事迈克尔·戈尔将讲述针对桑托斯的13项重罪指控，以及这对他在国会中的角色意味着什么。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, May 11th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月11日，星期四。

sentences.en: So, Michael, describe what happened in New York on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克尔，请描述一下周三在纽约发生了什么。

sentences.en: So, on Wednesday morning, Representative George Santos turned himself in to federal authorities at a courthouse in Long Island sometime before 9 a.m.
sentences.zh: 周三早上，众议员乔治·桑托斯在上午9点前向长岛一家法院的联邦当局自首。

sentences.en: There were tons of reporters outside, but we didn't actually see Mr. Santos in court until around 2 p.m.
sentences.zh: 外面有大量的记者，但直到下午2点左右，我们才在法庭上看到桑托斯先生。

sentences.en: When he entered, he was wearing a dark olive sweater, a blazer, and the thick-rimmed glasses that have been characteristic of his media appearances over the last several months.
sentences.zh: 他进来时穿着一件深橄榄色的毛衣、一件西装外套，还戴着过去几个月里他媒体形象标志性的厚框眼镜。

sentences.en: Right, his signature.
sentences.zh: 没错，他的标志。

sentences.en: His signature.
sentences.zh: 他的标志。

sentences.en: And Santos pleaded not guilty to the 13 counts against him, counts that mostly had to do with the mishandling of money.
sentences.zh: 桑托斯对针对他的13项指控表示不认罪，这些指控主要与资金处理不当有关。

sentences.en: He was then released on a $500,000 bond that was secured by three people whose identities we don't know.
sentences.zh: 随后他以50万美元的保释金获释，该保释金由三名我们身份不明的人担保。

sentences.en: And the judge told him that he could travel between his district and residence in New York and Washington, where he serves in Congress, and places in between.
sentences.zh: 法官告诉他，他可以在他的选区、纽约的住所、他任职国会的华盛顿以及中间地点之间往返。

sentences.en: And this indictment was the culmination of months of investigation by federal prosecutors in the Eastern District of New York, who also worked with the FBI and officials in the
sentences.zh: 这份起诉书是纽约东区联邦检察官数月调查的结晶，他们还与联邦调查局和

sentences.en: Nassau County District Attorney's Office.
sentences.zh: 拿骚县地方检察官办公室合作。

sentences.en: And much of the information detailed in the indictment follows reporting by the New York
sentences.zh: 起诉书中详述的大部分信息都追踪了《纽约

sentences.en: Times about George Santos.
sentences.zh: 时报》关于乔治·桑托斯的报道。

sentences.en: And Michael, what do we know about how authorities put this case together?
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我们对当局如何整理此案了解多少？

sentences.en: So the authorities started looking into Santos around the end of December, and their investigation
sentences.zh: 当局大约在12月底开始调查桑托斯，他们的调查

sentences.en: was sparked largely by reporting in the New York Times that uncovered that the congressman
sentences.zh: 很大程度上是由《纽约时报》的报道引发的，该报道揭露了这位国会议员

sentences.en: had lied substantially about his background in order to win a congressional seat on Long Island and Queens.
sentences.zh: 为了赢得长岛和皇后区的国会议席，在背景方面撒了弥天大谎。

sentences.en: And the lies were big and small.
sentences.zh: 谎言有大有小。

sentences.en: Santos said that his grandparents fled first from Ukraine and then from Belgium during World
sentences.zh: 桑托斯说他的祖父母在第二次世界大战期间先是从乌克兰逃到比利时，

sentences.en: War II.
sentences.zh: 然后又逃离。

sentences.en: He said that they were Jewish refugees who were escaping persecution during the Holocaust, which turned out not to be true.
sentences.zh: 他说他们是犹太难民，在大屠杀期间逃避迫害，但这被证明不是真的。

sentences.en: From there, he talks about his mother working her way up through the world of finance and eventually being in the World Trade Center on September 11th, 2001, though that turned out
sentences.zh: 从那里，他谈到他的母亲在金融界努力打拼，最终在2001年9月11日身处世界贸易中心，尽管事实证明

sentences.en: not to be the case.
sentences.zh: 并非如此。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's like he made up every single point of his biography, right?
sentences.zh: 就好像他编造了自己传记的每一个要点，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, I remember reading the headlines from that time and thinking, is there anything this guy said about who he is that's real?
sentences.zh: 就像我记得读到当时的头条新闻时心想，这家伙说的关于他是谁的话里，有什么是真的吗？

sentences.en: Like, he even lied about being a college volleyball star.
sentences.zh: 比如，他甚至谎称自己是大学排球明星。

sentences.en: He lied about being a college volleyball star.
sentences.zh: 他谎称自己是大学排球明星。

sentences.en: I mean, it was really ran the gamut.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这真的是包罗万象。

sentences.en: And our reporting also found a number of questions about Santos' financial disclosures.
sentences.zh: 我们的报道还发现了一些关于桑托斯财务披露的问题。

sentences.en: And in follow-ups, we and other outlets looked at questions around his campaign spending and personal finances.
sentences.zh: 在后续报道中，我们和其他媒体审视了围绕他竞选支出和个人财务的问题。

sentences.en: So as more reporting came out about Santos' lies, the federal authorities started to look into Santos.
sentences.zh: 因此，随着关于桑托斯谎言的报道越来越多，联邦当局开始调查桑托斯。

sentences.en: And we were able to report that the Justice Department had launched an investigation in late December.
sentences.zh: 我们能够报道司法部已于12月下旬展开调查。

sentences.en: But we didn't hear much about the details of that investigation.
sentences.zh: 但我们对调查的细节知之甚少。

sentences.en: It was fairly leak-proof.
sentences.zh: 它相当保密，没有泄露。

sentences.en: And it wasn't until Wednesday morning that the indictment was actually unsealed.
sentences.zh: 直到周三早上，起诉书才真正解封。

sentences.en: And we got a look at the case that federal prosecutors were bringing against him.
sentences.zh: 我们得以一窥联邦检察官对他提起的案件。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Okay, so let's go to the charges then.
sentences.zh: 好的，那我们来看看指控吧。

sentences.en: What are the charges?
sentences.zh: 指控是什么？

sentences.en: Walk me through them one by one.
sentences.zh: 请逐一为我梳理一下。

sentences.en: So there are 13 counts in this indictment, but the accusations center on three schemes.
sentences.zh: 起诉书中有13项指控，但指控集中在三个方案上。

sentences.en: And all of those schemes involve mishandling money or lying about funds.
sentences.zh: 所有这些方案都涉及资金处理不当或谎报资金。

sentences.en: The first and biggest scheme in the indictment is one involving Santos and an associate defrauding potential contributors to his political campaign.
sentences.zh: 起诉书中第一个也是最大的方案涉及桑托斯及其同伙欺骗其政治竞选活动的潜在捐款人。

sentences.en: So if you'll back up with me for a second, when a candidate runs for office, they launch their own campaign committee.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你和我一起回顾一下，当候选人竞选公职时，他们会成立自己的竞选委员会。

sentences.en: But they're often separately PACs or political action committees that are fundraising on their behalf.
sentences.zh: 但通常还有单独的政治行动委员会（PAC）代表他们筹款。

sentences.en: These are the organizations that people tend to donate to in order to support a candidate because they're not subject to the same contribution limits as a political campaign.
sentences.zh: 这些是人们倾向于捐款以支持候选人的组织，因为它们不受政治竞选那样的捐款限制。

sentences.en: So this is for political candidates, a huge bucket of money.
sentences.zh: 所以对于政治候选人来说，这是一个巨大的资金池。

sentences.en: And that money is supposed to be used only for paying things related to campaigning and an election.
sentences.zh: 这些钱应该只用于支付与竞选和选举相关的事项。

sentences.en: So that's advertisements, that's flyers, things that would help a candidate get elected.
sentences.zh: 也就是广告、传单，那些能帮助候选人当选的东西。

sentences.en: And Santos did have a number of PACs.
sentences.zh: 桑托斯确实有许多政治行动委员会。

sentences.en: But in addition to these more legitimate fundraising operations, the Justice Department says that
sentences.zh: 但除了这些更合法的筹款运作外，司法部表示，

sentences.en: he and an associate essentially made up a fake political committee in order to generate campaign contributions that Santos later used for personal expenses.
sentences.zh: 他和一名同伙本质上编造了一个虚假的政治委员会，以产生桑托斯后来用于个人开支的竞选捐款。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Like what types of expenses?
sentences.zh: 比如什么类型的开支？

sentences.en: So according to the indictment, Santos got at least $50,000 in donations.
sentences.zh: 根据起诉书，桑托斯获得了至少5万美元的捐款。

sentences.en: And he took the money and used it for luxury designer clothing, credit card payments, cash advances, and to pay down a car payment and other debt.
sentences.zh: 他拿了这笔钱，用于购买奢侈设计师服装、支付信用卡账单、预支现金，以及偿还汽车贷款和其他债务。

sentences.en: Pay down a car payment?
sentences.zh: 偿还汽车贷款？

sentences.en: A car payment, yeah.
sentences.zh: 汽车贷款，是的。

sentences.en: Okay, so there's a lot of sophistication to this alleged scheme, right?
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以这个所谓的方案非常复杂，对吧？

sentences.en: And it's right there also in the open, like for everybody to see.
sentences.zh: 而且它也就在光天化日之下，就像每个人都能看到的那样。

sentences.en: That's pretty audacious.
sentences.zh: 那真是太厚颜无耻了。

sentences.en: Yeah, and my colleagues actually caught wind of the beginnings of this back in January.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的同事实际上在1月份就察觉到了这件事的端倪。

sentences.en: We had heard that someone had been soliciting money for this fund that said it was raising money for Santos.
sentences.zh: 我们听说有人一直在为一个声称是为桑托斯筹款的基金募集资金。

sentences.en: And we checked with the Federal Election Commission to see if they had any information about that fund.
sentences.zh: 我们向联邦选举委员会核实，看他们是否有关于该基金的任何信息。

sentences.en: And it wasn't registered with them.
sentences.zh: 结果它并没有在他们那里注册。

sentences.en: And we had no idea where the money went.
sentences.zh: 我们根本不知道钱去了哪里。

sentences.en: So we didn't get more detail about that until the indictment.
sentences.zh: 所以直到起诉书出来，我们才得到更多细节。

sentences.en: Okay, so what's the second alleged scheme?
sentences.zh: 好的，那第二个所谓的方案是什么？

sentences.en: So the second scheme actually dates back to 2020.
sentences.zh: 第二个方案实际上可以追溯到2020年。

sentences.en: When Santos was making his first and maybe less noticed run for Congress.
sentences.zh: 当时桑托斯正在进行他第一次、也许也是不太引人注目的国会竞选。

sentences.en: Do you remember the CARES Act?
sentences.zh: 你还记得《CARES法案》吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I do.
sentences.zh: 是的，我记得。

sentences.en: Oh, how could I forget the CARES Act?
sentences.zh: 哦，我怎么会忘记《CARES法案》呢？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So the CARES Act, just as a refresher, gave extra unemployment money for people who lost their jobs during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 所以《CARES法案》，简单回顾一下，为在疫情期间失业的人提供了额外的失业救济金。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Santos, in June 2020, applied for unemployment benefits with the New York State Department of Labor.
sentences.zh: 桑托斯在2020年6月向纽约州劳工部申请了失业救济金。

sentences.en: And those benefits were funded by the CARES Act.
sentences.zh: 这些福利由《CARES法案》资助。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: To get those benefits, Santos said that he was unemployed.
sentences.zh: 为了获得这些福利，桑托斯声称他失业了。

sentences.en: And according to the indictment, he had to certify that he was unemployed every week.
sentences.zh: 根据起诉书，他必须每周证明他处于失业状态。

sentences.en: So according to the indictment, from June 2020 through April 2021, Santos told them that he was unemployed on a weekly basis.
sentences.zh: 所以根据起诉书，从2020年6月到2021年4月，桑托斯每周都告诉他们他失业了。

sentences.en: And he got more than $24,000 in funds from the government.
sentences.zh: 他从政府那里获得了超过24,000美元的资金。

sentences.en: But prosecutors say that at the time, he was actually working for an investment firm based in Florida making $120,000 a year.
sentences.zh: 但检察官表示，当时他实际上在佛罗里达州的一家投资公司工作，年薪12万美元。

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 哦，不。

sentences.en: So he's allegedly lying about being unemployed, stealing from the state in the middle of a pandemic when, of course, everybody is lining up to also get benefits.
sentences.zh: 所以他涉嫌谎称自己失业，在疫情期间窃取国家资金，而当时，当然，每个人都在排队领取福利。

sentences.en: Waitresses, hotel clerks, all over the map.
sentences.zh: 服务员、酒店职员，到处都是。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, he's making $120,000 a year in an investment firm?
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他在一家投资公司拿着12万美元的年薪？

sentences.en: That's what prosecutors say.
sentences.zh: 检察官是这么说的。

sentences.en: And one of the interesting footnotes to this today has been that Santos actually is one of 35 co-sponsors on a House bill specifically meant to target this issue and to help states
sentences.zh: 今天这件事的一个有趣的脚注是，桑托斯实际上是众议院一项法案的35名共同发起人之一，该法案专门针对这个问题，旨在帮助各州

sentences.en: recoup fraudulent or overly paid pandemic unemployment benefits.
sentences.zh: 追回欺诈性或超额支付的疫情失业救济金。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And one kind of interesting thing that happened today is House Republican leaders were talking about this bill and talking about this being a focal issue.
sentences.zh: 今天发生的一件有趣的事情是，众议院共和党领导人正在讨论这项法案，并谈到这是一个重点问题。

sentences.en: But at the same time, they were also saying that Santos was innocent until proven guilty and they didn't want to rush to make judgment on these accusations.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，他们也表示桑托斯在被证明有罪之前是无罪的，他们不想急于对这些指控做出判断。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So the DOJ is accusing him of lying about how he's spending his campaign money and unemployment fraud.
sentences.zh: 所以司法部指控他谎报竞选资金的使用方式以及失业欺诈。

sentences.en: What's the third scheme?
sentences.zh: 第三个方案是什么？

sentences.en: So the third scheme in the indictment is that Santos knowingly misrepresented his personal wealth when he filed financial disclosures with the House of Representatives in 2020 and
sentences.zh: 起诉书中的第三个方案是，桑托斯在2020年和
2022年向众议院提交财务披露时，故意歪曲了他的个人财富。

sentences.en: These are disclosures that candidates and members of Congress are required to make essentially
sentences.zh: 这些是候选人和国会议员必须进行的披露，本质上

sentences.en: to help deal with issues that might arise from conflicts of interest if they're elected or reelected.
sentences.zh: 是为了帮助处理如果他们当选或连任可能产生的利益冲突问题。

sentences.en: The one that he filed in 2022 is a bit of a doozy.
sentences.zh: 他在2022年提交的那份文件有点离谱。

sentences.en: And it was something that we'd raise in our initial story.
sentences.zh: 这也是我们在最初的报道中提出的问题。

sentences.en: On this form, Santos said that he was making $750,000 from his personal company, the Devolder
sentences.zh: 在这份表格上，桑托斯说他从他的个人公司Devolder

sentences.en: Organization.
sentences.zh: Organization赚取了75万美元。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And in the indictment, federal prosecutors are saying that that's not true.
sentences.zh: 在起诉书中，联邦检察官表示那不是真的。

sentences.en: On the form, he also said he had millions of dollars in savings.
sentences.zh: 在表格上，他还说他有数百万美元的储蓄。

sentences.en: And he said that his company was paying dividends between $1 and $5 million.
sentences.zh: 他说他的公司支付了100万到500万美元之间的股息。

sentences.en: And they said that that's not true.
sentences.zh: 他们说那也不是真的。

sentences.en: So overall, the picture that he's painting of himself in this 2022 form is that he's a very rich man making all this money from his business.
sentences.zh: 所以总的来说，他在2022年的表格中描绘的形象是他是一个非常有钱的人，从他的生意中赚了这么多钱。

sentences.en: And prosecutors are saying that that wasn't the case.
sentences.zh: 而检察官说事实并非如此。

sentences.en: But Michael, why would he do that?
sentences.zh: 但是迈克尔，他为什么要那样做？

sentences.en: Like, what's in it for him to overstate his finances like that?
sentences.zh: 他夸大自己的财务状况对他有什么好处？

sentences.en: I think it ties back to the image that Santos was giving of himself as he ran for office, especially in this most recent go-round.
sentences.zh: 我认为这与桑托斯在竞选公职时展现的形象有关，特别是在最近这一次竞选中。

sentences.en: And he's running in a district that covers a pretty wealthy part of Long Island with a lot of money managers, a lot of people who work on Wall Street, a lot of people who
sentences.zh: 他在长岛一个相当富裕的地区竞选，那里有很多基金经理，很多在华尔街工作的人，很多

sentences.en: work on finance.
sentences.zh: 从事金融工作的人。

sentences.en: You know, he was presenting himself as this experienced financier and this Wall Street guy.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他把自己包装成这位经验丰富的金融家和华尔街人士。

sentences.en: But presumably, he can't file a public disclosure that reveals that that's not the case if he's simultaneously telling voters that he's working for this wealthy family firm that
sentences.zh: 但据推测，如果他同时告诉选民他为这家他拥有的富裕家族公司工作，他就不能提交一份揭露事实并非如此的公开披露文件。

sentences.en: he owns.
sentences.zh: 他拥有的。

sentences.en: So this was essentially him selling an image of himself.
sentences.zh: 所以这本质上是他为自己打造的一种形象。

sentences.en: This was his story, that he was kind of birds of a feather of the people who were in his district.
sentences.zh: 这就是他的故事，他说自己和选区里的选民是同类人。

sentences.en: Well, that certainly seems to be what prosecutors are saying.
sentences.zh: 嗯，检察官似乎确实是这么说的。

sentences.en: They accuse him of misleading the House of Representatives and the public in an effort to kind of secure his seat.
sentences.zh: 他们指控他为了保住席位而误导众议院和公众。

sentences.en: But we've seen this pattern with him where he has been lying about all sorts of things, his personal life, his volleyball history, his work with an animal charity,
sentences.zh: 但我们已经看到他身上有一种模式，那就是他在各种事情上撒谎，比如他的私生活、他的排球经历、他参与的动物慈善机构，

sentences.en: his mom's ties to 9-11.
sentences.zh: 还有他母亲与“9·11”事件的联系。

sentences.en: The list goes on and on and on.
sentences.zh: 这样的例子不胜枚举。

sentences.en: And it's all in service of creating a very specific underdog inspirational life story.
sentences.zh: 而这一切都是为了打造一个非常具体的、励志的“失败者逆袭”人生故事。

sentences.en: But the thing that really strikes me, Michael, is like these charges don't have that much to do with the loudest and most public lies he told, right?
sentences.zh: 但迈克尔，真正让我感到震惊的是，这些指控与他所说的那些最响亮、最公开的谎言并没有太大关系，对吧？

sentences.en: Like being the descendant of a Holocaust survivor or working for Goldman Sachs.
sentences.zh: 比如自称是大屠杀幸存者的后代，或者曾在高盛工作。

sentences.en: The things that actually got him in trouble were the quiet lies, like the boring stuff he put on disclosure forMs.
sentences.zh: 真正让他陷入麻烦的是那些悄无声息的谎言，比如他在披露表格中填写的那些无聊的东西。

sentences.en: Yeah, my phone was blowing up this morning with texts from everyone, essentially being like, what do you mean wire fraud?
sentences.zh: 是啊，今天早上我的手机被各种短信轰炸，大家基本上都在问：你说的电信欺诈是什么意思？

sentences.en: What is this about?
sentences.zh: 这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: What about the lies about being Jewish?
sentences.zh: 那关于他是犹太人的谎言呢？

sentences.en: What about the lies about 9-11?
sentences.zh: 关于“9·11”的谎言呢？

sentences.en: What about the lies about Wall Street?
sentences.zh: 关于华尔街的谎言呢？

sentences.en: What about the lies about college?
sentences.zh: 关于大学学历的谎言呢？

sentences.en: But what we're seeing is a case that is much more technical and much more focused on finances than I think a lot of people might have expected.
sentences.zh: 但我们现在看到的案件要比很多人预想的更加技术化，也更加侧重于财务问题。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In the end, it comes down to boring wire fraud.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这就是无聊的电信欺诈。

sentences.en: As it so often does, it comes down to the money.
sentences.zh: 就像通常情况一样，最终还是为了钱。

sentences.en: Okay, so really sweeping range of charges.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以指控范围非常广泛。

sentences.en: What kind of sentence is Santos facing?
sentences.zh: 桑托斯面临什么样的刑罚？

sentences.en: If Santos is convicted on the top charges in this indictment, prosecutors say he could face up to 20 years in prison.
sentences.zh: 如果桑托斯被判处起诉书中的最高罪名，检察官称他可能面临最高20年的监禁。

sentences.en: At the same time, we aren't entirely sure whether there's other stuff that they may be investigating and whether this is the end of the indictment.
sentences.zh: 同时，我们也不完全确定他们是否还在调查其他事项，也不确定这是否就是起诉书的全部内容。

sentences.en: We know that prosecutors have talked to people regarding other leads.
sentences.zh: 我们知道检察官已经就其他线索与相关人员进行了交谈。

sentences.en: You know, they have looked at the work that
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们已经调查了

sentences.en: Santos did with his purported animal rescue charity, for example.
sentences.zh: 桑托斯声称参与的动物救援慈善机构的工作，例如。

sentences.en: None of that's represented in the indictment.
sentences.zh: 这些都没有出现在起诉书中。

sentences.en: So it's possible that there may be more to come.
sentences.zh: 所以未来可能还会有更多指控。

sentences.en: We just don't know yet.
sentences.zh: 我们现在还不得而知。

sentences.en: Okay, so we have a congressman facing federal charges.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以我们有一位面临联邦指控的国会议员。

sentences.en: How is that going to affect his role in Congress?
sentences.zh: 这会如何影响他在国会的角色？

sentences.en: Well, based on what we're hearing today, not a whole lot.
sentences.zh: 嗯，根据我们今天听到的消息，影响不大。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是维娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的“Connections”谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢试着捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天负责制作“Spelling Bee”和“Letterboxd”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 即可开始游戏。

sentences.en: Okay, so Michael, explain why exactly these charges might not have much of an effect on
sentences.zh: 好吧，迈克尔，解释一下为什么这些指控对

sentences.en: Santos and his role in Congress.
sentences.zh: 桑托斯及其在国会的角色可能没有太大影响。

sentences.en: So first of all, legally speaking, there's nothing in the Constitution that stops someone who's been accused or even convicted of a crime from serving in Congress.
sentences.zh: 首先，从法律上讲，宪法中没有任何条款阻止被指控甚至被判有罪的人在国会任职。

sentences.en: People are innocent until proven guilty, obviously.
sentences.zh: 显然，在被证明有罪之前，人们都是无辜的。

sentences.en: But theoretically, Santos, if he were convicted and sentenced to prison, could serve from prison.
sentences.zh: 但理论上，如果桑托斯被定罪并被判入狱，他甚至可以在狱中任职。

sentences.en: He just wouldn't be able to vote in the House.
sentences.zh: 他只是无法在众议院投票而已。

sentences.en: Whoa, interesting.
sentences.zh: 哇，有意思。

sentences.en: And that's just strictly logistics and the legal context.
sentences.zh: 这纯粹是后勤和法律层面的情况。

sentences.en: But I think maybe more importantly for him, Santos is sort of being insulated by the politics of the moment and by House Speaker
sentences.zh: 但我认为对他来说更重要的是，桑托斯在某种程度上受到了当前政治局势和众议院议长

sentences.en: Kevin McCarthy.
sentences.zh: 凯文·麦卡锡的庇护。

sentences.en: Okay, so explain that.
sentences.zh: 好吧，解释一下。

sentences.en: How's he being insulated?
sentences.zh: 他怎么受到庇护了？

sentences.en: So one thing to note is that Santos has actually already been stripped of some of his power and standing in Congress.
sentences.zh: 需要注意的一点是，桑托斯实际上已经被剥夺了在国会的部分权力和地位。

sentences.en: In January, he said that he was going to step down from the two House committees to which he'd been assigned.
sentences.zh: 一月份，他表示将辞去被分配的两个众议院委员会的职务。

sentences.en: And we know now that he did so because of pressure from
sentences.zh: 我们现在知道他这样做是因为受到了

sentences.en: Kevin McCarthy and House Republican leadership.
sentences.zh: 凯文·麦卡锡和众议院共和党领导层的压力。

sentences.en: At the same time, Santos is still a pretty vital vote for McCarthy and House Republicans.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，桑托斯对麦卡锡和众议院共和党人来说仍然是一个非常关键的票数。

sentences.en: You know, the Republican Party has a pretty slim majority.
sentences.zh: 你知道，共和党的多数优势非常微弱。

sentences.en: They've only got four votes in the House.
sentences.zh: 他们在众议院只有四个席位的优势。

sentences.en: And that caucus is very fragmented right now.
sentences.zh: 而且目前的党团会议非常分散。

sentences.en: McCarthy has been facing challenges from people who are further to his right and further to Santos' right.
sentences.zh: 麦卡锡一直面临着来自比他更右、比桑托斯更右的人的挑战。

sentences.en: And so far, Santos has been a fairly reliable vote for McCarthy.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，桑托斯一直是麦卡锡相当可靠的投票支持者。

sentences.en: So House Republicans need him in order to get their legislative priorities done.
sentences.zh: 所以众议院共和党人需要他来完成他们的立法优先事项。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Like McCarthy has very little room to maneuver, right?
sentences.zh: 就像麦卡锡几乎没有回旋余地一样，对吧？

sentences.en: And losing Santos would give him even less room.
sentences.zh: 失去桑托斯会让他回旋余地更小。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I think that's especially crucial to consider right now in light of the debt ceiling standoff that's happening in Washington.
sentences.zh: 我认为考虑到华盛顿目前发生的债务上限僵局，这一点尤其关键。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You know, there's going to be a vote on that sometime soon.
sentences.zh: 你知道，不久之后就会对此进行投票。

sentences.en: And Santos has said that he would vote to support McCarthy on this bill.
sentences.zh: 桑托斯已经表示，他会投票支持麦卡锡的这项法案。

sentences.en: McCarthy needs his vote.
sentences.zh: 麦卡锡需要他的票。

sentences.en: But I think even beyond the immediate future and the debt ceiling vote, McCarthy's kind of making a calculation here based on politics.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，即使撇开眼前的未来和债务上限投票不谈，麦卡锡在这里也是基于政治进行盘算。

sentences.en: And what is that calculation?
sentences.zh: 那是什么样的盘算？

sentences.en: So if Santos were to resign this year, you would need to hold a special election in order to replace him in Congress.
sentences.zh: 如果桑托斯今年辞职，你就必须举行特别选举来填补他在国会的空缺。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And it's worth noting that Santos actually flipped his district in 2022.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，桑托斯实际上在2022年翻转了他的选区。

sentences.en: It had been held by a Democrat for a decade.
sentences.zh: 该选区此前由民主党人把持了十年。

sentences.en: And there's no guarantee that another Republican would win if Santos were to resign.
sentences.zh: 如果桑托斯辞职，不能保证会有另一位共和党人获胜。

sentences.en: And so McCarthy's vote margin would go from four to three.
sentences.zh: 所以麦卡锡的投票优势将从四票变成三票。

sentences.en: And what's McCarthy saying?
sentences.zh: 麦卡锡是怎么说的？

sentences.en: In America, we'll just follow the same pattern we always have, right?
sentences.zh: 在美国，我们只会遵循我们一贯的模式，对吧？

sentences.en: If a person is indicted, they're not on committees, they have the right to vote, but they have to go to trial.
sentences.zh: 如果一个人被起诉，他们就不会进入委员会，他们有投票权，但他们必须接受审判。

sentences.en: McCarthy has largely been defending Santos's right to stay in Congress.
sentences.zh: 麦卡锡在很大程度上一直在捍卫桑托斯留在国会的权利。

sentences.en: I'll look at the charges.
sentences.zh: 我会看看这些指控。

sentences.en: He said that he would not pressure Santos to resign over these federal charges, but that he might reconsider if Santos were to be convicted.
sentences.zh: 他说他不会因这些联邦指控而向桑托斯施压要求其辞职，但如果桑托斯被定罪，他可能会重新考虑。

sentences.en: And other House Republican leaders doubled down on that position on Wednesday morning.
sentences.zh: 其他众议院共和党领导人在周三上午也重申了这一立场。

sentences.en: In America, there's a presumption of innocence, but there are serious charges.
sentences.zh: 在美国，有无罪推定原则，但这些指控很严重。

sentences.en: He's going to have to face the charges that he has.
sentences.zh: 他将不得不面对他所面临的指控。

sentences.en: With Representative Steve Scalise.
sentences.zh: 与众议员史蒂夫·斯卡利斯一起。

sentences.en: This is not the first time a member of Congress from either party has been indicted.
sentences.zh: 这并不是两党国会议员第一次被起诉。

sentences.en: And Elise Stefanik both saying that they would let the legal process play out and that they wouldn't rush to take action against Santos based solely on the indictment.
sentences.zh: 埃莉斯·斯特凡尼克都表示，他们会让法律程序顺其自然，不会仅仅根据起诉书就急于对桑托斯采取行动。

sentences.en: Okay, so leadership is definitely not going to get rid of him.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以领导层绝对不会让他走人。

sentences.en: But what about the rest of Congress?
sentences.zh: 但国会的其他人呢？

sentences.en: So in order to expel Santos from the House, the House of Representatives would need a two-thirds vote.
sentences.zh: 为了将桑托斯逐出众议院，众议院需要三分之二的投票。

sentences.en: And there are certainly some Republicans who have called on Santos to resign, and we saw a few more add to that handful on Wednesday morning.
sentences.zh: 当然，确实有一些共和党人呼吁桑托斯辞职，我们在周三上午看到又有几个人加入了这个行列。

sentences.en: But the coalition that wants Santos to step aside is far from two-thirds of the total House of Representatives.
sentences.zh: 但希望桑托斯下台的联盟远未达到众议院总数的三分之二。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There are other options.
sentences.zh: 还有其他选择。

sentences.en: Santos could, of course, decide to resign at any time, though all indications from him suggest that he has no intention of doing so.
sentences.zh: 桑托斯当然可以随时决定辞职，尽管他所有的迹象都表明他无意这样做。

sentences.en: And it's possible that Santos might agree to a plea deal.
sentences.zh: 桑托斯也有可能同意认罪协议。

sentences.en: So if that were to happen, House Republicans might feel pressured to force him to resign since he would be acknowledging that some of these accusations against him were, in fact,
sentences.zh: 如果发生这种情况，众议院共和党人可能会感到压力，迫使他辞职，因为他将承认针对他的一些指控实际上是

sentences.en: true.
sentences.zh: 真实的。

sentences.en: And it's entirely possible that he could offer to step down as part of whatever deal he might make, should he make such a deal with federal prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 他完全有可能提出辞职，作为他可能达成的任何协议的一部分，如果他确实与联邦检察官达成了这样的协议。

sentences.en: And how likely is that scenario?
sentences.zh: 这种情况发生的可能性有多大？

sentences.en: I mean, that he would take a plea deal.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他会接受认罪协议吗？

sentences.en: You know, at this point, it's pretty hard to say.
sentences.zh: 你知道，目前很难说。

sentences.en: Santos just saw the charges on Wednesday morning, just like the rest of us.
sentences.zh: 桑托斯和我们其他人一样，也是在周三早上才看到这些指控的。

sentences.en: So it's going to take some time for him and his lawyer to evaluate them and figure out what their next option is.
sentences.zh: 所以他和他的律师需要一些时间来评估这些指控，并找出他们的下一个选择。

sentences.en: So a plea deal wouldn't happen immediately if it happens at all.
sentences.zh: 所以如果真的有认罪协议，也不会立即发生。

sentences.en: And the other possibility is that, given all the scrutiny, Santos could decide not to seek re-election.
sentences.zh: 另一种可能性是，鉴于所有的审查，桑托斯可能会决定不再寻求连任。

sentences.en: But he just announced his re-election bid two weeks ago, and already he is fundraising off of today's court proceedings,
sentences.zh: 但他两周前才宣布竞选连任，而且他已经利用今天的法庭诉讼进行筹款了，

sentences.en: suggesting that voters might want to give him some money in order for him to continue to fight for freedom of some kind.
sentences.zh: 暗示选民可能想给他一些钱，以便他能继续为某种自由而战。

sentences.en: Whoa.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was a real turn.
sentences.zh: 是的，这真是一个转折。

sentences.en: So far, he has really shied away from using the scandal or the controversy in order to fundraise.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，他确实避开了利用丑闻或争议来筹款。

sentences.en: But it sounds like what you're saying is that really, when it comes down to it, any form of real accountability is going to have to come from a conviction or from the voters,
sentences.zh: 但听起来你的意思是，归根结底，任何形式的真正问责都必须来自定罪或选民，

sentences.en: because, you know, it's not going to come from his own party in Congress.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，这不会来自他在国会的政党。

sentences.en: That certainly seems to be the case.
sentences.zh: 情况似乎确实如此。

sentences.en: You know, there's not enough pressure on him at the moment from the people in Congress who actually matter and help make these decisions to get him to resign.
sentences.zh: 你知道，目前国会中那些真正重要并有助于做出这些决定的人并没有给他施加足够的压力让他辞职。

sentences.en: And we know that Santos remains pretty unpopular in his district.
sentences.zh: 而且我们知道桑托斯在他的选区仍然很不受欢迎。

sentences.en: There was polling from January that found that 78 percent of voters in his district wanted him to step down.
sentences.zh: 一月份的民意调查显示，他选区内78%的选民希望他下台。

sentences.en: But he's not bowing to that pressure.
sentences.zh: 但他并没有屈服于这种压力。

sentences.en: And so it looks like he's going to be a member of the House for the foreseeable future.
sentences.zh: 所以看起来在可预见的未来，他仍将是众议院的一员。

sentences.en: And what does Santos himself say?
sentences.zh: 桑托斯本人怎么说？

sentences.en: So we actually heard from Santos after the hearing on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 我们在周三听证会后确实听到了桑托斯的声音。

sentences.en: Are you going to speak for me?
sentences.zh: 你要替我说话吗？

sentences.en: He came out of the courthouse and was immediately mobbed by reporters and TV cameras.
sentences.zh: 他走出法院，立即被记者和电视摄像机团团围住。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好了。

sentences.en: I know you all have questions.
sentences.zh: 我知道你们都有问题。

sentences.en: I know that everybody's been waiting for the moment for me to come out and talk to you guys.
sentences.zh: 我知道大家都在等我出来和你们谈谈的这一刻。

sentences.en: And in his remarks to the media, he sounded incredibly defiant.
sentences.zh: 他在对媒体发表讲话时，听起来极其挑衅。

sentences.en: We have an indictment.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了起诉书。

sentences.en: We have all we have the information that the government wants to come after me.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有政府想要对付我的一切信息。

sentences.en: Now I'm going to have to go and fight to defend myself.
sentences.zh: 现在我必须去战斗，为自己辩护。

sentences.en: The reality is, is it's a witch hunt.
sentences.zh: 事实是，这是一场猎巫行动。

sentences.en: I'm going to fight my battle.
sentences.zh: 我要打我的仗。

sentences.en: I'm going to deliver.
sentences.zh: 我会兑现承诺。

sentences.en: I'm going to fight the witch hunt.
sentences.zh: 我要对抗这场猎巫行动。

sentences.en: I'm going to take care of clearing my name.
sentences.zh: 我要洗清我的名声。

sentences.en: And I look forward to doing that.
sentences.zh: 我很期待这样做。

sentences.en: He said that this is a witch hunt and promised that he would ultimately clear his name.
sentences.zh: 他说这是一场猎巫行动，并承诺他最终会洗清自己的名声。

sentences.en: Hold on.
sentences.zh: 等一下。

sentences.en: I would like the opportunity for some of you guys to ask some questions in an orderly fashion.
sentences.zh: 我想给你们一些人一个机会，以有序的方式提出一些问题。

sentences.en: And we'll start right here.
sentences.zh: 我们从这里开始。

sentences.en: Go ahead.
sentences.zh: 请讲。

sentences.en: As he took questions, he seemed to grow increasingly more frustrated with the press and increasingly more defiant.
sentences.zh: 在他回答问题时，他似乎对媒体越来越沮丧，也越来越挑衅。

sentences.en: George, George.
sentences.zh: 乔治，乔治。

sentences.en: I have a bill that helps save the COVID money, yet you're being alleged that—
sentences.zh: 我有一项法案可以帮助挽救新冠疫情资金，但你们却指控我——

sentences.en: Well, it's alleged, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这只是指控，对吧？

sentences.en: So are you accusing me?
sentences.zh: 所以你是在指责我吗？

sentences.en: Are you going to allow the process to play itself and allow me to clear my name?
sentences.zh: 你打算让程序自行运作，让我洗清罪名吗？

sentences.en: And he basically abruptly ended the press conference, waved to the press, got into a car, and sped away.
sentences.zh: 他基本上突然结束了新闻发布会，向媒体挥了挥手，坐进车里，疾驰而去。

sentences.en: I mean, what do you make of all of this in the end?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你最终如何看待这一切？

sentences.en: So if I can take you back for a second to answer this question.
sentences.zh: 如果能让我回到刚才，回答这个问题。

sentences.en: When you look at that first week, his first day on Capitol Hill, I was there, and he looked very quiet and very ashamed.
sentences.zh: 当你回顾第一周，他来到国会山的第一天时，我就在那里，他看起来非常安静，也非常羞愧。

sentences.en: And then I think as he realized the exact nature of this Republican caucus, that it was very fragmented, that if he could reliably vote for McCarthy,
sentences.zh: 后来我想，当他意识到这个共和党党团的具体性质，即它非常分散，如果他能可靠地投票支持麦卡锡，

sentences.en: McCarthy had little incentive to do anything about him.
sentences.zh: 麦卡锡就没什么动力对他采取任何行动。

sentences.en: He seems to have become bolder and bolder and bolder.
sentences.zh: 他似乎变得越来越大胆了。

sentences.en: And he seemed to realize that he had a firm grip on his seat in Congress.
sentences.zh: 他似乎意识到自己牢牢掌握着国会席位。

sentences.en: And he reaches a point where he feels comfortable running for re-election in April, which is a calculation that he seems to be making,
sentences.zh: 他觉得自己可以安心参加四月份的连任竞选，这似乎是他做出的盘算，

sentences.en: that he's going to weather this storm and make it to 2024, and that he can go beyond that.
sentences.zh: 他认为自己能挺过这场风暴，撑到2024年，甚至走得更远。

sentences.en: But now he's looking at this legal case, and that's a lot harder to avoid.
sentences.zh: 但现在他面临着这起法律案件，这可就没那么容易避开了。

sentences.en: And it's the kind of thing that the political reality of Washington can't get you out of.
sentences.zh: 这是华盛顿的政治现实无法让你脱身的那种事情。

sentences.en: Michael, thank you.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, former President Donald Trump appeared on a major television network for the first time since 2020, and through a stream of lies, half-truths, and name-calling,
sentences.zh: 周三，前总统唐纳德·特朗普自2020年以来首次出现在一家大型电视网络上，通过一连串的谎言、半真半假的话和人身攻击，

sentences.en: showed that he had not changed his politics.
sentences.zh: 表明他的政治立场并未改变。

sentences.en: January 6th, it was the largest crowd I've ever spoken to.
sentences.zh: 1月6日，那是我演讲过的规模最大的人群。

sentences.en: Speaking at a town hall held by CNN in New Hampshire, Trump praised January 6th rioters and said he would pardon many of them.
sentences.zh: 在CNN于新罕布什尔州举行的市民大会上，特朗普称赞了1月6日的骚乱者，并表示他将赦免其中许多人。

sentences.en: They were there proud, they were there with love in their heart.
sentences.zh: 他们去那里感到自豪，他们带着爱心去那里。

sentences.en: That was an unbelievable, and it was a beautiful day.
sentences.zh: 那是一个令人难以置信的、美好的日子。

sentences.en: He once again refused to concede that he had lost the 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 他再次拒绝承认自己在2020年大选中落败。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 还有……

sentences.en: I don't believe they're going to do a default because I think the Democrats will absolutely cave.
sentences.zh: 我不认为他们会违约，因为我认为民主党人绝对会屈服。

sentences.en: He counseled Congress to let the federal government default on its debt if President Biden did not agree to the deep spending cuts that Republicans have demanded.
sentences.zh: 他建议国会，如果拜登总统不同意共和党要求的深度削减开支，就让联邦政府债务违约。

sentences.en: And scientific advisors to the federal government gave the first indication that the birth control pill might soon be available without a prescription.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府的科学顾问首次暗示，避孕药可能很快无需处方即可购买。

sentences.en: A panel of experts to the Food and Drug Administration voted unanimously that the benefits of making birth control available over the counter outweighed the risks.
sentences.zh: 美国食品药品监督管理局的一个专家小组一致投票认为，让避孕药非处方化带来的好处大于风险。

sentences.en: It was a significant step in the decades-long push to make oral contraception available on a mass scale.
sentences.zh: 这是几十年来推动口服避孕药大规模普及的重要一步。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Mary Wilson, Eric Krupke, and Diana Wynn.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由玛丽·威尔逊、埃里克·克鲁普克和戴安娜·韦恩制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Liz O'Balen, Rachel Quester, and Michael Benoit.
sentences.zh: 由莉兹·奥巴伦、雷切尔·奎斯特和迈克尔·贝努瓦编辑。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Dan Powell and Marian Lozano.
sentences.zh: 包含丹·鲍威尔和玛丽安·洛萨诺的原创音乐。

sentences.en: And was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 由克里斯·伍德担任工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsverk of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹维克创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们准备聊聊假期接待客人的事。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全遮光才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会睡到不省人事。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台收听《Wirecutter秀》。
